newsitem.title: INDONESIA: East Timor's Bishop Belo arrives back in Dili.
newsitem.headline: East Timor's Bishop Belo arrives back in Dili.

text.p: East Timorese Bishop Carlos Belo, focal point for demonstrations by thousands of supporters in the territory this week, arrived at Dili airport on Saturday, a witness said.
The witness said about 200 people had gathered in an orderly way at Komoro airport just west of the East Timor capital.
"He has just arrived," the witness told Reuters by phone from the airport information counter.
Police said about 500 people had been driving around the small coastal city since early morning in anticipation of the bishop's return from Jakarta.
Thousands of people have demonstrated daily since Tuesday in support of Belo against Indonesian criticism of the Nobel peace prize laureate.
